tei:div.tei:p: (321)ram̐ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i gtor chen yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor rdzas dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i sha yi ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho rus pa'i gram khrod glad zhag gi lbu phreng 'khrigs pa/ dam tshig tu 'os pa'i 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang med pa/ ngo bo zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

'bru gsum/ rtsa sngags la gtor sngags btags pa gsum gyis phul nas/ tha/ 1 ÓÓ sgram sgram Ó 3 byas 1 skyang nas drag brdung 'bring po/ dmar chen gtor zor la 'jug (322)hūm̐/ dmar chen gtor zor phur pa'i tshogs/ sde brgyad dregs pa'i dpung dang bcas/ dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du rbad/ srid pa g.yo zhing 'khrugs byed pa'i/ dmag dpung der spyod g.yul ngor sprod/ dgra dpung chom la bgegs dpung thul/ rjes shul lhag ma med par mjod/ dus la babs so mthu rtsal bskyed/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mjod/// /
